faqs.q: What is the Bosch Rexroth A10VSO 100 variable axial piston pump used for?
faqs.a: The Bosch Rexroth A10VSO 100 is a variable-displacement axial piston pump of swashplate design for open-circuit hydrostatic drives, with a displacement of 100 cm³/rev. Flow is proportional to drive speed and displacement, and the displacement changes steplessly with the swashplate angle.

faqs.q: What sizes and part numbers are listed for the Bosch Rexroth A10VSO 100 variable axial piston pump?
faqs.a: The listing is the A10VSO 100, series 31, with a displacement of 100 cm³/rev, weighing 49.5 kg or 55.4 kg with a through drive. Rexroth positions series 31 as its all-purpose medium-pressure pump in sizes 18 to 100, with a two-hole ISO 3019-2 flange with a 125 mm pilot.

faqs.q: How do I choose the right size or model of the Bosch Rexroth A10VSO 100 variable axial piston pump?
faqs.a: Quote the full Rexroth type code from your nameplate, such as A10VSO 100 DR/31R-VPA12N00, so we supply the same configuration. The code gives size 100, the control, series 31, rotation R or L, seals (V for FKM), drive shaft, mounting flange, port plate and through drive.

faqs.q: What pressure rating does the Bosch Rexroth A10VSO 100 variable axial piston pump have?
faqs.a: Rexroth states 280 bar nominal and 350 bar maximum pressure for the A10VSO 100, with a maximum speed of 2000 rpm at full displacement. Theoretical flow is 150 L/min at 1500 rpm and 200 L/min at 2000 rpm, before efficiency losses.

faqs.q: Which materials is the Bosch Rexroth A10VSO 100 variable axial piston pump offered in?
faqs.a: The standard seals are FKM (V), and the pump runs on HLP mineral oil to DIN 51524-2 with an operating viscosity of 10 to 400 mm²/s, optimum 16 to 36 mm²/s, up to +110 °C at the drain port with FKM seals. HFA, HFB and HFC fluids need the E version.

faqs.q: Which standards apply to the Bosch Rexroth A10VSO 100 variable axial piston pump?
faqs.a: The listing gives the mounting as an ISO 3019-2 two-hole flange, the ports as SAE flange ports to ISO 6162-1, the fluid as HLP oil to DIN 51524-2 and the filtration as ISO 4406 20/18/15 or better. No certificate is held on the listing; ask for Rexroth's data sheet if you need it.

faqs.q: Which parts does the Bosch Rexroth A10VSO 100 variable axial piston pump mate with?
faqs.a: A through drive, K01, K52, K68, K04, KB2, KB3, KB4 or K57, lets the pump carry a second pump of up to the same size on the same drive, or N00 for none. Controls are DG, DR, DFR, DFR1, DRG, ED72, ER72 and DFLR.
